mechanism: v15 forces equal weights on the first5 within-hour power ticks and adds weight only to the last tick. Test ONE general convex six-tick filter per lead: nonnegative weights summing to1, fitted by least squares on the available chronological training prefix. Twelve stored weights/ten free coefficients. Translation equivariant, no intercept, target clipping or extrapolative state.
training_evidence: Read-only original-train residual audit: after fitting v15 on each prefix, orthogonalized earlier ticks remain correlated with subsequent TRAIN query errors, up to0.34, but signs/strength drift and o80 correlations are weak. This is an exploratory motivation, not proof that a filter generalizes. No outer labels fit or select weights.
data_contract: Same exact hourly labels, seven-channel history, input72/h2/stride3, six turbines, scaler and evaluation windows. Same raw source and conservative issue-10min last-tick availability as v15. Retain all6 observed power ticks from the completed hour instead of only their mean and endpoint. Reconstruct mean to1e-8kW; missing/mismatched ticks stop, never drop windows. No future raw tick, weather forecast or operating-state label.
optimizer: One convex quadratic fit per lead, implemented by enumerating all63 nonempty faces of the six-weight simplex and solving equality-constrained KKT systems. These are optimizer active sets on the SAME FIT outcomes, not predictive candidates/validation searches. Fixed numerical tolerances only; v15 feasible weights win loss ties. No regularization, seed, threshold or iteration-budget search.
partition: Reuse v12 three purged chronological TRAIN origins70/80/90. v15 baseline coefficients/checkpoints are strictly reused after checking actual inputs, labels, windows and source hashes. New filter fits the SAME prefix. Only if it passes all3 train blocks, refit once on all original outer-train and freeze before any new outer prediction.
selection: New filter must jointly be MAE/RMSE non-worse than BOTH cached v15 and Persistence in EVERY training query block, tolerance1e-8, and mean per-block error ratio vs v15<1-1e-8. Otherwise retain EXACT prior v15, record negative TRAIN results and STOP with no new outer evaluation. No runner-up, refit epoch, per-fold model search or outer-triggered change.
comparisons: Primary reference is frozen v15 two-scalar end-state model, not only Persistence. Additional same-cohort historical neural references lack the within-hour information and have different training budgets; do not claim architecture/Wiki or tuned-SOTA superiority.
budget: Three small filter fits; at most ONE final all-train fit and ONE outer report if training gate passes. No neural training, additional folds/seeds/algorithms or retrying negative experiments. CPU only, own BLAS/OpenMP2threads, never initialize CUDA or alter other users' processes.
primary_success: If admitted, outer MAE AND RMSE must improve over BOTH frozen v15 and Persistence. Report MSE/R2/Skill/capacity hit rates/lead-specific errors and paired time-block intervals/Newey-West. Prior outer periods were development-inspected; not independent confirmation.
forbidden: reporting fallback v15 as a new accuracy gain
